story.title: The Great Tomato Launch Fiasco
story.question: Can an over-engineered pneumatic produce launcher survive a crowded farmer's market?
story.answer: Yes, by abandoning speed for extreme precision and hitting every customer's basket simultaneously.

story_beats.headline: The Catastrophic Test
story_beats.speech: Behold the Tomato-matic Ninety-Ninth, guaranteed to deliver fresh produce across the entire square in mere seconds flat!
story_beats.label: The Setup
story_beats.visual_prompt: Inventor Barnaby stands in a crowded marketplace next to a hissing brass mechanical launcher, wearing oil-stained overalls and safety goggles, holding a wrench while terrified market vendors duck.

story_beats.headline: Climbing Pressure
story_beats.speech: The gauge is entering the red zone now! Quick, hand me the extra rubber gaskets before the brass tank explodes!
story_beats.label: The Build
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby frantically twists a glowing red pressure valve on the steaming brass launcher while his nervous assistant Cora holds a box of rubber gaskets in the bustling market square.

story_beats.headline: The Wild Discharge
story_beats.speech: Duck under your market stalls! Thousands of ripe red tomatoes are flying completely out of control in every direction!
story_beats.label: The Mechanism
story_beats.visual_prompt: A chaotic blur of ripe red tomatoes arcs through the air above crowded market awnings while frightened shoppers cower and Barnaby chases the vibrating launcher with outstretched arms.

story_beats.headline: Perfect Delivery
story_beats.speech: Look at that! Every single basket caught a fresh tomato without a single bruise or dent anywhere in sight!
story_beats.label: The Finale
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby and Cora smile proudly beside the now-cool brass launcher as smiling market vendors hold up baskets filled with perfectly caught tomatoes under festive hanging string lights.

story.central_conflict: Pneumatic fruit launcher over-pressurizes and threatens to destroy the entire vegetable square.
story.decisive_choice: Re-routing the main pressure valve into a network of hand-held umbrella catchers.
story.resolution: Every shopper receives free tomatoes safely and the inventor gets a permanent stall.

visual_bible.style: Bright stop-motion claymation aesthetic with rich vibrant textures and warm daylight.

characters.Barnaby: An eccentric inventor with wild gray hair, wearing oil-stained brown overalls and oversized brass safety goggles.
characters.Cora: A practical assistant wearing a green apron, canvas trousers, and holding a wooden toolbox.

locations.MarketSquare: A bustling cobblestone town square lined with striped canvas awnings and wooden vendor stalls.

objects.Launcher: A massive, steampunk pneumatic brass cylinder decorated with copper pipes, pressure gauges, and a large red starter lever.

story.title: The Beacon Ridge Rescue
story.question: Can the veteran climber reach the lost explorer before the snowstorm buries the canyon?
story.answer: Yes, by trusting a glowing emergency signal and scaling the fractured ice wall.

story_beats.headline: The Distant Flash
story_beats.speech: Look closely at that ridge. A faint SOS signal is flashing through the blowing snow and freezing fog.
story_beats.label: The Signal
story_beats.visual_prompt: An experienced rescuer wearing the heavy waterproof yellow parka and thermal climbing pants specified in the character bible points toward a jagged mountain ridge, where a faint blinking SOS emergency light shines through blowing snow and freezing fog.

story_beats.headline: The Frozen Timber
story_beats.speech: We must navigate this dense pine forest quickly because the freezing temperatures will drain their battery soon.
story_beats.label: The Forest
story_beats.visual_prompt: The rescuer wearing thick mountaineering boots and a yellow parka strides purposefully through a dark, snow-draped pine forest holding an active GPS device.

story_beats.headline: The Cleft Entrance
story_beats.speech: Hold onto the anchor rope tightly while I descend into this deep crevasse to reach the injured climber.
story_beats.label: The Cleft
story_beats.visual_prompt: The rescuer leaning over the edge of a dark icy crevasse in the rock face, securing a heavy metal carabiner to a frozen steel piton driven into the stone.

story_beats.headline: The Safe Ascent
story_beats.speech: We made it just in time. The rescue helicopter is lowering the winch harness to pull us both up.
story_beats.label: The Rescue
story_beats.visual_prompt: The rescuer and the wrapped hiker standing together on a snowy ledge, looking up as a silver rescue helicopter hovering overhead lowers a bright yellow rescue harness.

story.central_conflict: A sudden blizzard traps an injured hiker in a remote alpine crevasse.
story.decisive_choice: Abandon the safe lower trail to climb the treacherous vertical ice face.
story.resolution: The hiker is safely hoisted onto the rescue helicopter just before sunset.

visual_bible.style: Realistic cinematic winter photography with crisp textures and dramatic lighting.

characters.lead_rescuer: A rugged middle-aged climber with a weathered face, intense focus, wearing a heavy waterproof yellow parka and thermal climbing pants.

locations.mountain_ridge: A steep alpine environment featuring jagged grey granite rocks, deep snowdrifts, and towering frozen pine trees.
locations.icy_crevasse: A narrow vertical fissure in the glacier with glistening blue-tinted ice walls.

objects.gps_device: A rugged handheld electronic gadget with a glowing amber screen and rubberized black edges.
objects.rescue_rope: A thick, high-strength braided red nylon climbing rope with reinforced steel carabiners.

story.title: The Magnetic Hull Leak
story.question: Can the engineering crew patch the magnetic stabilizer before solar radiation fries the main drive?
story.answer: Yes, by manually rerouting coolant through the auxiliary conduit under extreme pressure.

story_beats.headline: Warning Claxons Blaze
story_beats.speech: Warning alarms echo across the bridge as radiation levels spike past critical limits and the hull groans.
story_beats.label: Reactor Core Warning
story_beats.visual_prompt: Chief Engineer Vane standing at the glowing orange bridge console, pointing angrily at a cracked plasma gauge while Pilot Jax sits behind him looking worried.

story_beats.headline: The Heated Disagreement
story_beats.speech: We must vent the forward thrusters immediately before the pressure overload fractures the entire starboard engine assembly.
story_beats.label: Thruster Debate
story_beats.visual_prompt: Pilot Jax in the grey mission-patched flight jacket urgently operates the forward-thruster vent controls in the cramped engineering bay as pressure gauges drop from critical red; Chief Engineer Vane in his stained canvas jumpsuit watches the starboard engine pressure readout, with the venting action clearly visible.

story_beats.headline: The Emergency Override
story_beats.speech: Hand me the cryogenic sealant canister now, because I am overriding the manual locks to freeze this reactor leak.
story_beats.label: Manual Override
story_beats.visual_prompt: Chief Engineer Vane smashing his palm against the flashing red emergency override keypad while holding a pressurized silver coolant cylinder.

story_beats.headline: Stable Orbit Achieved
story_beats.speech: The weld held against the solar shockwave, and our reactor temperatures are finally returning to safe operational baselines.
story_beats.label: Stable Flight
story_beats.visual_prompt: Both crew members relaxing in the softly lit cockpit, watching a blue and green planet fill the main viewport as the warning lights finally turn off.

story.central_conflict: Disagreement between Chief Engineer Vane and Pilot Jax over whether to vent forward thrusters or shield the core during a solar flare.
story.decisive_choice: Chief Engineer Vane overrides the automated flight computer to force a cold-weld seal directly onto the vibrating reactor plate.
story.resolution: The hull seal holds firm against the solar wave, saving the vessel and restoring full propulsion to the crew.

visual_bible.style: Cinematic sci-fi realism with gritty industrial textures, stark metallic lighting, and high contrast shadows.

characters.Vane: A weathered chief engineer with a greying buzzcut, wearing a stained canvas jumpsuit with reinforced leather elbow pads.
characters.Jax: A cautious pilot with braided dark hair, wearing a sleek grey flight jacket adorned with embroidered mission patches.

locations.bridge: A cramped circular control room featuring banks of amber analog dials, glowing toggle switches, and a massive curved observation window.
locations.engineering_bay: A narrow industrial corridor lined with exposed copper piping, vibrating hydraulic pistons, and heavy safety grates.

objects.wrench: A heavy, dual-ended titanium spanner with deep scratches along the handle.
objects.canister: A cylindrical steel cryogenic coolant container frosted over with white ice crystals.
objects.keypad: An angled metal control panel featuring three physical toggle switches and a glowing red indicator light.
